languages._comment: Override or add language packs here. Keys: months, months_short, present, date_month_year, date_long, documents, filenames, labels, apply_labels (link texts that lead to the form). See jobapply/i18n.py for the built-in de/en packs.

_comment_editor: Command `jobapply open` and the [e] key in `run` use to open a file, e.g. "code -r" for VS Code.
_comment_home_country: Spellings of your own country; the cover letter omits the country line when the employer's address matches one.
